activity_summary: You asked Richard how to mend a walk the back would have to come on. He cut a stick to your hip rather than your shoulder, and you took that length. The six pairs were said for, and not your walk today. Anne said she would walk you when the light was off the street, and she would not name the place in the kitchen. You left the sheets and the inkhorn. You did not call the back eased.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Asked, accepted the hip-high stick, and agreed not to know the name yet.
